1.consolidated_definition: pl. Conjunto de 50 yaguas o envolturas de la rama de palma real. Las yaguas se usaban para cubrir las paredes de la vivienda campesina.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Conjunto of 50 or bundles of the palm frond of the royal palm tree. The yaguas were used to cover the walls of rural peasant dwellings.
